canonical_project: 川东大数据中心 (Chuandong / East Sichuan Big Data Center)
owner: China Telecom Sichuan / Dazhou municipal partners
notes: Dazhou municipal article says the center is open and operating with Sugon, Alibaba Cloud, Baidu data labeling and others signed; Xinhua/CNFIN reported Nov. 2022 opening, total investment RMB1bn, 60 mu site, 800 phase-1 racks and 3,000 phase-2 planned racks, PUE under 1.25, 32T egress bandwidth.
